label: High-Distress Heavy-Use Graduate Women
summary: This profile captures highly educated women who spend more than five hours daily on digital platforms and report elevated levels of loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety. Their UCLA-8 loneliness scores (mean 1.73), PHQ-9 depression scores (mean 1.73), and GAD-7 anxiety scores (mean 2.13) are all in the higher range, suggesting a co-occurring pattern of psychological distress. With 184 respondents in this cluster, the profile represents a sizable subgroup characterized by compounded mental health challenges alongside heavy screen engagement.
demographic_anchor: Female, graduate-level education or above, more than 5 hours of daily screen/platform use
behavior_markers: Elevated loneliness scores (UCLA-8 mean ≈ 1.73) indicating persistent feelings of social disconnection
Higher depressive symptom burden (PHQ-9 mean ≈ 1.73) suggesting frequent low mood and related difficulties
Notably high anxiety levels (GAD-7 mean ≈ 2.13), the most pronounced distress indicator in the profile
Heavy daily digital engagement exceeding 5 hours, potentially reflecting both occupational demands and coping behavior
Co-occurrence of all three distress dimensions, pointing to a compounded psychological vulnerability pattern
tone: Empathetic and clinically attentive, acknowledging significant concurrent distress without pathologizing

label: Well-Adjusted Male Graduate
summary: This profile represents respondents who report notably low levels of loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms. With mean scores well below scale midpoints on the UCLA-8, PHQ-9, and GAD-7 measures, these individuals demonstrate strong psychological well-being across all three assessed dimensions. They are characterized by moderate daily screen time (1–3 hours) and higher educational attainment.
demographic_anchor: Male, graduate-level education or above, 1–3 hours of daily screen time
behavior_markers: Reports minimal loneliness (UCLA-8 mean ≈ 0.72, well below scale midpoint)
Exhibits very low depressive symptomatology (PHQ-9 mean ≈ 0.31)
Maintains moderate screen time of 1–3 hours per day
Holds graduate-level or higher educational qualifications
tone: Stable, psychologically resilient, and emotionally well-regulated
